statement.zh: 希拉孔波利斯是上埃及前王朝–早王朝关键中心；Quibell 1900 与 Quibell & Green 1902 报告神庙区发掘与主窖藏（与纳尔迈调色板及相关早期王权器物传统关联）。
statement.en: Hierakonpolis is a key Upper Egyptian Predynastic–Early Dynastic center; Quibell 1900 and Quibell & Green 1902 report temple-area work and the Main Deposit (linked to the Narmer Palette and related early royal objects).

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-ancient-egypt.md only.
